classes.name: IGESBasic_Group
classes.summary:
defines Group, Type <402> Form <1> in package {@link IGESBasic | `IGESBasic`} The Group Associativity allows a collection of a set of entities to be maintained as a single, logical entity
Group, OrderedGroup, GroupWithoutBackP, OrderedGroupWithoutBackP share the same definition (class Group), form number changes
non Ordered, non WithoutBackP : form 1 non Ordered, WithoutBackP : form 7 Ordered, non WithoutBackP : form 14 Ordered, WithoutBackP : form 15

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a Group with a predefined count of items (which all start as null).

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class Group.
- allEntities : Used to store pointers to members of the Group.

instanceMethods.name: SetOrdered
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a Group to be, or not to be Ordered (according mode).

instanceMethods.name: SetWithoutBackP
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a Group to be, or not to be WithoutBackP.

instanceMethods.name: IsOrdered
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if <me> is Ordered.

instanceMethods.name: IsWithoutBackP
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if <me> is WithoutBackP.

instanceMethods.name: SetUser
instanceMethods.comment: Enforce a new value for the type and form.

instanceMethods.name: SetNb
instanceMethods.comment: Changes the count of item If greater, new items are null If lower, old items are lost.

instanceMethods.name: NbEntities
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of IGESEntities in the Group

instanceMethods.name: Entity
instanceMethods.comment: returns the specific entity from the Group

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: returns the specific entity from the Group

instanceMethods.name: SetValue
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a new value for item <Index>.

classes.name: IGESBasic_Hierarchy
classes.summary: defines Hierarchy, Type <406> Form <10> in package {@link IGESBasic | `IGESBasic`} Provides ability to control the hierarchy of each directory entry attribute.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (nbPropVal: number, aLineFont: number, aView: number, anEntityLevel: number, aBlankStatus: number, aLineWt: number, aColorNum: number): void
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class Hierarchy.
- nbPropVal : Number of Property values = 6
- aLineFont : indicates the line font
- aView : indicates the view
- aEntityLevel : indicates the entity level
- aBlankStatus : indicates the blank status
- aLineWt : indicates the line weight
- aColorNum : indicates the color num aLineFont, aView, aEntityLevel, aBlankStatus, aLineWt and aColorNum can take 0 or 1. 0 : The directory entry attribute will apply to entities physically subordinate to this entity. 1 : The directory entry attribute of this entity will not apply to physically subordinate entities.

instanceMethods.name: NbPropertyValues
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of property values, which should be 6

instanceMethods.name: NewLineFont
instanceMethods.comment: returns the line font

instanceMethods.name: NewView
instanceMethods.comment: returns the view

instanceMethods.name: NewEntityLevel
instanceMethods.comment: returns the entity level

instanceMethods.name: NewBlankStatus
instanceMethods.comment: returns the blank status

instanceMethods.name: NewLineWeight
instanceMethods.comment: returns the line weight

instanceMethods.name: NewColorNum
instanceMethods.comment: returns the color number
